title: Razorpay IPO: Revenue +65% but Rs 1,209 Cr loss #Shorts
description: Razorpay filed its DRHP with SEBI for a Rs 6,000 Cr IPO. Valued at $5 billion — down from a $7.5B peak in 2021. FY25 revenue: Rs 3,783 Cr (+65% YoY). Net loss: Rs 1,209 Cr. Over 8 crore businesses rely on Razorpay. India's most-used payment gateway is going public. Follow Fin Pulse for market updates.
